params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $relay=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $origin=(git -C $relay remote get-url origin).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('hcp-vrebase-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); git clone --quiet --branch agent/hcp-verification-wire-20260929-0806 --single-branch $origin $tmp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; try { $before=(git -C $tmp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if($before -ne '6830c3ca2c31af9c1864f5ee05e9e8aded668ade'){ throw ('branch moved unexpectedly: '+$before) }; git -C $tmp fetch --quiet origin main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git -C $tmp rebase origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $after=(git -C $tmp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); git -C $tmp push --force-with-lease origin HEAD:agent/hcp-verification-wire-20260929-0806; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output ('BEFORE='+$before); Write-Output ('REBASED_SHA='+$after); Write-Output ('BASE='+(git -C $tmp merge-base HEAD origin/main).Trim()) } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
